ios.desc:
Take control of your health and nutrition with Bitelogix – the smart, easy-to-use tracker designed to help you reach your fitness goals, whether you’re aiming to lose weight, gain muscle, or maintain a healthy lifestyle.

Track your meals, calories, macros, and nutrients with ease. Bitelogix gives you a full picture of your progress through simple charts, AI-powered summaries, and intuitive daily logging tools.

Key Features:
Meal & Calorie Tracking – Log food, calories, protein, carbs, fats, and more

Custom Goals – Set nutrition, weight, or fitness goals based on your plan

Smart Dashboards – Visualize progress with clean graphs and insights

Favorites & Quick Logging – Save frequent meals and recipes

Simple, Modern Interface – Built for speed and clarity

Whether you're focused on cutting, bulking, or staying consistent, Bitelogix adapts to your routine and keeps you on track.

Eat smart. Track better. Live stronger—with Bitelogix.
